title: API Vault
description: Schema for api-vault. The UI reads this file to populate form tooltips and validate entries. Add new fields here and they will appear in the editor automatically.

provider.description: Name of the service or platform (e.g. GitHub, Stripe, Jackett).

account_name.description: Username, handle, or email for the account.

api_key.description: Primary API key, access token, or personal access token.

api_secret.description: Secret that pairs with the key (client secret, shared secret, etc.).

key_id.description: Disambiguator when one provider has multiple keys (e.g. stripe_test, stripe_live). Used in generated .env variable names.

api_description.description: Technical description of what this key does. Shown on the card by default.

description.description: Personal context — which project uses this, caveats, notes. Hidden behind a toggle.

price_type.description: Pricing model: free = free tier; local = self-hosted; paid = active subscription; conditional = invite/membership/ratio-based.

categories.description: User-defined category tags. Must match entries in user_categories.

api_url.description: The base API endpoint URL where requests are sent (e.g. https://api.github.com).

callback_url.description: OAuth redirect URI or webhook callback URL registered with the provider.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). UI will warn when this key is close to or past expiry.

scopes.description: Permission scopes granted to this key (e.g. ["repo", "read:user"]).

custom_icon.description: Simple Icons slug to use as provider icon (e.g. "github"). Overrides auto-detection.

user_categories.description: Master list of user-defined category names. All category values in api_keys must come from this list.
